predictions.selection_reason: user-controlled hostname parameter -> unsanitized interpolation into shell command -> potential command injection vulnerability
predictions.source_summary: hostname parameter passed to resolve function
predictions.sink_summary: shell.exec(cmd, {silent: true}) executes the constructed command
predictions.guard_summary: No sanitization or validation of hostname before interpolation into shell command. The dns-lookup-script.js uses process.argv[2] directly in dns.lookup() but the shell command construction is vulnerable.
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled hostname parameter is directly interpolated into shell command without sanitization, allowing command injection via shell metacharacters
predictions.context_summary: The resolve function takes hostname parameter, constructs a shell command using util.format with nodeBinary, scriptPath, and hostname, then executes it via shell.exec. The script dns-lookup-script.js uses dns.lookup() but the vulnerability is in the shell command construction.
unresolved_facts: How the resolve function is called and what controls exist on the hostname parameter at call sites

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: user-controlled hostname parameter directly interpolated into shell command without sanitization, allowing command injection via shell metacharacters

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-77 command-injection command-construction shell exec spawn process subprocess child_process os.system popen argument-delimiter metacharacter
top_sast_rules.remediation: Keep external data separate from command syntax and use safe argument APIs.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Using externally controlled strings in a command line may allow a malicious user to change the meaning of the command.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-088. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.
